antiphona-i: Whosoever shall confess Me * before men, him will I confess also before My Father.
antiphona-ii: He that followeth Me * walketh not in darkness, but shall have the light of life, saith the Lord.
antiphona-iii: If any man serve Me, * let him follow Me; and where I am, there shall also My servant be.
antiphona-iv: If any man serve Me, * him will my Father, Who is in heaven, honour, saith the Lord.
antiphona-v: Father, I will * that where I am, there shall also My servant be.

datum: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: + for, when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, * which God hath promised to them that love Him.
V. Thou hast crowned him with glory and honour, O Lord.
R. And madest him to have dominion over the works of Thy hands.
This man is holy, * for he hath striven for the law of his God even unto death, and hath not feared for the words of the ungodly: for he had his foundation upon a strong rock.
The Lord He is the King of the Martyrs. * O come, let us worship Him!

antiphona-i: In the law of the Lord * was his delight day and night.
antiphona-ii: To declare * His decree, the Lord hath set him upon His holy hill.
antiphona-iii: With my voice, * I cried unto the Lord, and He heard me out of His holy hill.

datum: V. The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree.
R. He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
